method.mechanism: Agent hypothesis: subtracting the mean of preceding encoded states can emphasize a current interest that differs from established history. Keep the incumbent current-state coefficient at 0.85. The candidate uses -0.15 times preceding context; the generated control uses +0.45, giving equal-magnitude, opposite-sign changes of 0.30 times context relative to the incumbent's +0.15. Preserve the incumbent fallback when no predecessor exists.
